items.title: Define Story Capsule contract and storage APIs
items.context: Add capsule.json, session-brief.md, handoff.md and story-scoped capsule directory under configured storyDir; no-capsule session_brief must degrade cleanly.
items.userSees: koala capsule_show --story B-42c0 prints a JSON/markdown capsule summary from .koala/story/actives/B-42c0/capsule, while a story with no capsule prints a clear no capsule yet message.

happy.desc: Create/read capsule contract under configured storyDir and render basic summary.

edge.desc: Story without capsule returns graceful empty state without throwing.

adversarial.desc: Fixture with storyDir=.koala/story/actives proves implementation does not hardcode docs/story or Docs/story.

items.title: Record run summaries and metrics under capsule/runs
items.context: Add run.json, transcript.md, metrics.json, artifacts.json support with provider/role/result/commands/evidence/process-event references while avoiding full chat transcript persistence.
items.userSees: koala capsule_run_add records a run and koala capsule_show shows Last run: implementer/pass with command, role, provider, evidence refs, and metrics summary.

happy.desc: capsule_run_add persists run.json, transcript.md, metrics.json, and artifacts.json for a valid checklist run.

edge.desc: Long transcript input is summarized/truncated rather than stored as full chat by default.

adversarial.desc: Invalid checklistId/storyId run add is rejected and does not leave partial run files.

items.title: Connect capsule projection to process-events and rebuild
items.context: Emit capsule_updated, handoff_written, run_metrics_recorded events and add a rebuild path so capsule.json can be regenerated from process-events plus evidence.

items.title: Productize capsule CLI and session_brief integration
items.context: Add capsule_show, capsule_update, capsule_handoff, capsule_run_add and ensure koala session_brief renders Current Story Capsule without becoming noisy.

items.title: Bind capsule references to evidence and gate diagnostics
items.context: Validate evidenceRefs/processEventRefs exist; forged session-brief.md cannot satisfy DONE and missing refs fail or warn according to command/gate context.

items.title: Add non-authoritative OMX import and complete tests
items.context: Implement capsule_import_omx as explicit non-authoritative import, keep .omx optional, and add smoke/contract tests for all new commands, rebuild, session_brief output, and fake evidence resistance.
